item.title: Brazilian football player Kathleen Souza converts to Islam
item.description: A 29-year-old Brazilian footballer Kathleen Souza, who plays for Saudi Arabian team Al-Nassr, has converted to Islam.

item.title: 10 killed, 14 injured in Karachi gas cylinder blast
item.description: At least 10 people have been killed and 14 others injured after a gas cylinder exploded in the Soldier Bazaar area of Karachi, Pakistan.

item.title: 214 Afghans freed from Pakistani prisons return home
item.description: The Ministry of Refugees and Repatriation (MoRR) announced on Thursday that 214 Afghan migrants, recently released from prisons in Pakistan, have returned to Afghanistan.

item.title: Budget cuts hamper fight against Afghan malnutrition crisis: WFP
item.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) in Afghanistan says a budget shortfall has forced it to turn away three out of every four malnourished children in the country.

item.title: Indian businessman keen to open gemstone showroom in Afghanistan
item.description: An Indian businessman has expressed interest in establishing a gemstone exhibition showroom in Afghanistan and in facilitating links between Afghan and Indian traders in the pharmaceutical sector.
